Oliver —

Thanks for the context and the PO. Appreciate the heads-up on the VAT/residency side — that helps. A couple quick thoughts:

- We can do structured invoice splits. Typical patterns that work well operationally are 2x-per-month or weekly micro-invoices. Weekly will increase AR overhead but can reduce per-invoice size and help cashflow.
- For a temporary credit cap increase: we can do a short-term bridge under a conditional exception, but finance will need some guardrails (see Priyom).
- To expedite: can you confirm the exact entity to invoice (US or EU) and confirm whether ACH is possible? ACH plus e-invoicing reduces hold times.

If acceptable, Priyom (cc'd) will outline the exact documentation and timeline. Vanessa — can you look at our billing cadence options and confirm API/CSV delivery for split invoices?

If we can get ACH and the VAT proof today, we should be able to route a provisional credit bump while we validate.

Best,

Thanks, Oliver / Marcus — Priyom here (AR lead). Happy to coordinate. To evaluate a provisional credit increase and map the invoice split operationally, we'll need the following before we can approve anything formal:

1) 12-month payment history or most recent 6 months (if available) — helps with short-term underwriting.
2) Copy of the PO (we have a stub) and any statement of work that ties usage to spend.
3) Entity to invoice confirmation (legal name, tax ID, billing address). If invoices are to the US entity, include US EIN; if EU, include VAT ID and whether reverse-charge applies.
4) ACH details (bank name, routing, account number) or confirmation that AP team will set up a wire schedule.
5) Point-of-contact in your AP team (name + phone/email) for quick clears.

Provisional approval path we propose:
- Short-term bridge to $200k credit cap for up to 60 days, conditional on ACH setup and receipt of items 1–4 within 3 business days.
- Split invoices: we will pilot twice-weekly invoices for Aug/Sep, auto-reconciled with our billing API. We can revert to biweekly after the pilot if operational load is high.
- Early payment incentive: 1% credit on invoices paid within 7 days to encourage fast clears (optional).

I've attached an AR checklist and a minimal docs template to speed collection. Once we have the docs, I can fast-track a provisional exception and notify accounting to extend the bridge.

Attachment: AR_requirements.xlsx (stub)

If you want to hop on a quick call to walk through the ACH setup and the split cadence today, I have slots 2:00–3:00pm PT.

— Priyom
